Australia has an overall safety risk rated as very-low. Violent crime is low and petty crime (pickpocketing, scams) is low. The US State Department advises: Exercise Normal Precautions. Reissued after periodic review with minor edits.
Exercise normal precautions in Australia.
Read the country information page for additional information on travel to Australia.
If you decide to travel to Australia:

Enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) to receive alerts and make it easier to locate you in an emergency.
Review the Country Security Report for Australia.
Prepare a plan for emergency situations. Review the Traveler’s Checklist.
Visit the CDC page for the latest Trav For solo female travelers: Very safe. Standard city precautions apply at night. Remote areas require planning for safety (distances, limited services).. LGBTQ+ safety: Very welcoming. Same-sex marriage legal since 2017. Sydney's Mardi Gras is one of the world's largest LGBTQ+ events. Generally safe everywhere.. Natural disaster risks include: bushfires, floods, cyclones (north), sharks, venomous wildlife.
In Australia, call 000 for police, 000 for ambulance/medical emergency, and 000 for fire services.

Australia has a Universal (Medicare — Australian public healthcare, for residents and eligible visitors) healthcare system, rated excellent quality. Typical costs for tourists: System: Universal (Medicare — Australian public healthcare, for residents and eligible visitors) Quality: ★★★★★ (5/5) World-class healthcare with excellent hospitals and highly trained doctors. English is universal. Medicare ( Australia's public healthcare system) is NOT available to most tourists — you must have travel insurance. Private healthcare is excellent and accessible. Wait times in public ERs can be long. 💡 Medical Tourism Australia is a destination for high-end medical care but not typically a 'budget' medical tourism destination. Known for cosmetic surgery and specialist treatments.. Pharmacy access: easy. Access: easy Hours: Most pharmacies open 8:30am-5:30pm weekdays, with some late-night and weekend hours. Major chains include Chemist Warehouse, Priceline, and Terry White. In rural areas, pharmacy access is more limited. Prescription rules: Australian prescriptions are required for most medications. Foreign prescriptions are generally not accepted — you'll need an Australian doctor's prescription. Some medications available OTC elsewhere require prescriptions in Australia. 💡 Tips Pharmacies are widely available in cities and towns. Many medications require a prescription. Some OTC items available without prescription include basic painkillers, antihistamines, and antacids. Pharmacists can advise on minor ailments. Recommended vaccinations: Hepatitis A, Hepatitis B, COVID-19 (following current guidelines), MMR (ensure routine vaccines are current), Influenza (seasonal). Malaria risk is negligible. Travel insurance advice: ⚠️ Strongly recommended Average cost: $50-100/week 💡 Tip Australia has reciprocal healthcare agreements with the UK, Ireland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Finland, Italy, Belgium, Slovenia, Malta, and Norway — citizens of these countries can access Medicare for medically necessary treatment. All others need full travel insurance. Medical evacuation from remote areas (which are common) is extremely expensive — ensure your policy covers this. 💡 Tip Australia has reciprocal healthcare agreements with the UK, Ireland, Sweden, the Netherlands, Finland, Italy, Belgium, Slovenia, Malta, and Norway — citizens of these countries can access Medicare for medically necessary treatment. Adelaide is a destination in Australia. Adelaide is a high-utility urban base in Australia with strong local food, walkable core districts, and enough city energy to earn a few full days. Known for: City, Cultural, Food. Budget level: $$$$. Best time to visit: Sep–Nov. Currency: Australian dollar (AUD). Primary language: English. Tap water is safe to drink. Tipping: Tipping is optional; round up or leave about 10% only for strong service.. Visa: Visa rules depend on your passport and trip length; verify requirements before booking..
